entities.summary: Conny Clara Aerts, born 26 January 1966, is a Belgian (Flemish) professor in astrophysics. She specialises in asteroseismology. She is associated with KU Leuven and Radboud University, where she leads the Chair in the Astroseismology group. In 2012, she became the first woman to be awarded the Francqui Prize in the category of Science & Technology. In 2022, she became the third woman to be awarded the Kavli Prize in Astrophysics for her work in asteroseismology. Conny Aerts was a writers & intellectuals from Brasschaat (b. 1966-01-26, Brasschaat). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Conny Aerts' work in asteroseismology has significantly advanced our understanding of stellar structure and evolution, with her research contributing to the development of new detection methods for exoplanet atmospheres. Her awards, including the Kavli Prize in Astrophysics, recognize her impact on the field.
